name: Akemi
source:
Name: Akemi, "Lizard Woman"
Sex: Likely Female
Age: 29 (Self-Declared)
Birthday: July 16
Profession: Escape Game Hostess
Likes: Round Things, Fluffy Things, CUTE Things, Harajuku, Chatting
Dislikes: Pollen, Natural Remedies, Internet Connection Problems, [spoiler]Things that are bad for Hina[/spoiler]
Hobbies: Collecting cutesy things, Surfing the Internet
Skills: Testing viruses, [spoiler]Instantly finding Hina's location and leading her wherever she wants[/spoiler]

A Reptilian and hostess of the Third Eye Game. She's trapped [url=/c85762]Iris[/url], presenting the rules and progress of the game to her from behind a monitor.
[spoiler]In actuality, she is an AI which [url=/c151122]Hina[/url] created by copying [url=/c155395]Sakura Asahi[/url]'s personality and thoughts.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character description]
